comment: The sixteen crosspoint knobs and sixteen mute buttons are configured in a loop with the index left off (configParam(CV_PARAM, ...) rather than CV_PARAM + i), so only the first of each gets a name and thirty of the thirty-two params have an empty tooltip. Rack's own config() still gives every param a 0 to 1 quantity, so all of them work; only the tooltips are lost.
